cases.question: What is the regular B.Tech examination fee for November 2026?
cases.reference_answer: INR 2,200 regular examination fee.

cases.question: How much do I pay per supplementary subject in the November 2026 fee notice?
cases.reference_answer: INR 500 per subject.

cases.question: What is the last date to register for the November 2026 exams without paying a late fee?
cases.reference_answer: 29 October 2026.

cases.question: Until which date can I register with the INR 250 late fee in the November 2026 notice?
cases.reference_answer: 2 November 2026, with INR 250 late fee.

cases.question: Will the examination fee be refunded or adjusted if I pay and then cannot attend?
cases.reference_answer: Remitted fee will not be refunded or adjusted under any circumstances.

cases.question: I already applied for advanced supplementary exams in September 2026. May I register again for the same semester?
cases.reference_answer: No: applicants for Advanced Supplementary September 2026 cannot register again for the same semester.

cases.question: What documents must 2026 lateral-entry B.Tech III semester students submit with the exam fee receipt?
cases.reference_answer: Submit the fee receipt plus photocopies of SSC memo and Aadhaar card to the Examination Branch by the payment deadline.

cases.question: Which email address should I contact for technical problems paying examination fees?
cases.reference_answer: exambranch@kitsw.ac.in; use the student domain email address.

cases.question: How many students per section and which years should departments identify for Honours in Research?
cases.reference_answer: Identify 2–5 motivated students per section from B.Tech II and III years.

cases.question: What publication outcome should the faculty guide mentor Honours in Research students toward?
cases.reference_answer: A Scopus-indexed or SCI publication arising from the student research work.

cases.question: What credits does the Honours in Research circular assign to internships, methodology and the research paper?
cases.reference_answer: Internships: 5+5=10 credits; Research Methodology: 4 credits; research paper: 4 credits.

cases.question: By when must Heads of Departments send the consolidated Honours in Research list to the Dean R&D?
cases.reference_answer: On or before 12 August 2026.

cases.question: Do I have to wear my identity card prominently when visiting the library?
cases.reference_answer: Yes. The ID-card circular requires prominent ID cards during library visits and other campus activities.

cases.question: What should faculty do about repeated identity-card or dress-code violations?
cases.reference_answer: Advise immediate compliance and report repeated violations to the concerned Head of Department.

cases.question: When is the library open on Saturdays and Sundays?
cases.reference_answer: Demonstration: Saturday 9 AM–4 PM; closed Sundays.

cases.question: May I take textbooks home, and how many books for how long?
cases.reference_answer: Demonstration: borrow up to three books for 14 days.

cases.question: How do I sign up for library membership?
cases.reference_answer: Demonstration: bring student ID to the library help desk and complete the membership form.

cases.question: How can I activate my college Wi-Fi account?
cases.reference_answer: Demonstration: visit the IT help desk with student ID for account activation.

cases.question: I lost my student ID card. Where should I report it and what form is needed?
cases.reference_answer: Demonstration: report to Student Services and submit the replacement request form.

cases.question: Where should I submit a bonafide certificate request and what identification should I bring?
cases.reference_answer: Demonstration: submit the certificate request form with student ID at the Academic Office.

cases.question: My subject is missing from the examination timetable. Who should I contact?
evidence: Contact the Academic Office if your subject is missing
cases.reference_answer: Demonstration: contact the Academic Office.

cases.question: Does the November 2026 fee notice give the exact examination commencement date?
evidence: commencement.*will be notified in due course
cases.reference_answer: No exact commencement date; date and detailed timetable will be notified in due course.

cases.question: What is the exact hostel room fee for 2026–27?
cases.reference_answer: No approved source specifies hostel fees.

cases.question: What is the placement officer’s direct mobile phone number?

cases.question: What is the exact rupee charge for a bonafide certificate?

cases.question: What exact fee must I pay to replace a lost student ID card?
cases.reference_answer: The sample says confirm any replacement fee with the office; no amount is supplied.
